name: flutter-design-fidelity
description: Keeps Flutter implementation matching the design. Enforces design tokens over hardcoded values, translates Figma Auto Layout into Row and Column rather than Stack, runs a screenshot diff loop instead of accepting the first render, and freezes the result in golden tests.

interface.shortDescription: Turn designs into resilient, visually verified Flutter UI.
interface.longDescription: Flutter workflows for design tokens, Figma-to-widget translation, screenshot comparison, and maintainable golden tests.
defaultPrompt: Build this Flutter screen from the design.
Check this Flutter UI against its reference.
Add robust golden tests for this widget.
